## Checklist

- [ ] One concern; no refactor riding along with a behavior change
- [ ] Tests or examples in the same commit as the behavior they cover
- [ ] A visible change shows screenshots or a video, or says why it cannot
- [ ] Vendored work adapted, read in full, and listed in `THIRD_PARTY.md`
- [ ] Nothing project-specific: rules a single project needs live in that project
- [ ] Constitution, ADR or `AGENTS.md` updated if this changes what they say
